title: Round-Robin Pointer Decrements Instead of Increments
rtl:
always_ff @(posedge clk)
  if (gnt_done) last_gnt <= last_gnt - 1;  // Rotates backwards
expected_root_cause: The priority pointer decrements after each grant (last_gnt - 1) instead of incrementing, causing the arbiter to rotate backwards (3→2→1→0) rather than the required forward order (0→1→2→3).
description: The priority pointer decrements after each grant, causing arbitration to rotate in reverse order (3→2→1→0) instead of forward (0→1→2→3).
success_log: Grant order verified as 0→1→2→3→0. Forward round-robin confirmed.
